title: AgentContext
description: Structured context returned with task.get and task.create responses so AI agents start with full state instead of re-explaining. Caps at 32KB serialized; over-cap responses set truncated:true and return next_page_tokens for follow-up calls to related_tasks.list and events.list.

related_tasks.description: Tasks blocking, blocked-by, or otherwise related. Not exhaustive; pagination via next_page_tokens.related_tasks. Capped to fit the 32KB envelope.

recent_events.description: Most-recent events on this task and adjacent tasks, newest first. Pagination via next_page_tokens.recent_events. Capped to fit the 32KB envelope.

ref.description: Implementation-specific reference. For commits: SHA. For branches: branch name. For PRs/issues: number or full URL. For files: repo-relative path.

repo_refs.description: Repo references attached to this task. Empty until populated by a future context-update verb.

truncated.description: True if any field was cut to fit the 32KB cap. Clients seeing truncated=true SHOULD call related_tasks.list / events.list with next_page_tokens for full data.

next_page_tokens.description: Opaque pagination cursors. Only present when truncated=true.
